nodes.name: YC Work at a Startup - Fetch (SCRAPER STUB)

parameters.content:
## 1. Source Fetch
RemoteOK, Remotive, We Work Remotely, Himalayas use real public API/RSS feeds and are enabled.

Wellfound, Dynamite Jobs, YC Work at a Startup and Otta have **no public API/RSS** and require JS-rendered scraping or login. Those 4 nodes are disabled stubs — plug in a scraping service (Apify, ScrapingBee, Browserless) and an HTML Extract node, then enable + wire into the matching Normalize node. See README.

nodes.name: Normalize - YC Work at a Startup

parameters.content:
## 2-3. Normalize + Keyword Match
Every source is mapped to a common schema, then filtered down to items whose title/description/tags contain at least one of the search keywords, focused on AI Agent roles (async remote, work from anywhere, ai agent engineer, agentic ai, llm agent, ai automation engineer, langchain, crewai, etc).

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Get Existing Job URLs

parameters.content:
## 4-6. Normalize -> Dedupe -> Raw Jobs
job_url is the primary unique key; company+job_title is the fallback key. New jobs get logged to the 'Raw Jobs' tab before any eligibility filtering happens, so nothing found is ever silently lost.

## 7. Taiwan Hard Filter
Keyword reject rules (US/Canada/UK/EU/Australia-only, hybrid/onsite, must-be-based-in, fixed US/EU hours) run first as a cheap filter before any AI call. Also enforces a freshness rule: only jobs whose posted_date falls in the current calendar month are recommended -- older postings are rejected as 'stale_posting' (unknown/unparseable dates are NOT rejected). Rejects go straight to the Rejected tab with a reason category used later in the digest's rejection summary.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Append Rejected (AI Country Check)

parameters.content:
## 8. AI Taiwan Eligibility
Calls Claude with the exact eligibility prompt from the spec per job. Parses the JSON verdict. 'no' -> straight to Rejected. 'yes'/'unclear' continue down the pipeline carrying location_risk/timezone_risk fields used later in scoring + final decision.

## 9. Async Filter
Tags async_level (high/medium/low) from keyword signals and hard-rejects strict-hours-required postings (fixed EST/PST/CET, daily live calls, full business-day overlap).

## 10. Scoring + Final Decision
Scores Taiwan eligibility (0-40), async fit (0-25), AI Agent role fit (0-25 -- AI Agent Engineer/Developer, Agentic AI, LLM agent, multi-agent systems, AI automation/workflow, prompt/RAG engineer, chatbot dev) and salary (0-25). decision = apply_immediately / manual_check / keep_review / reject, following the spec's step-14 rules exactly. Anything below 70 or high-risk is rejected here.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Update Cover Letter Draft

parameters.content:
## 11-13. Filtered Jobs, Instant Alert, Cover Letter
Score >= 70 (and decision != reject) writes to Filtered Jobs. Score >= 85 also triggers an immediate Telegram ping and an AI-drafted cover letter (<=220 words) saved back into the sheet row.

## 14. Daily Digest
Combines the Filtered Jobs list and every Rejected reason into one message: top jobs (score sorted), manual-check list, and a rejection breakdown (US only / EU only / hybrid / timezone risk / stale posting counts). Sent via both Telegram and Gmail — disable whichever channel you don't want.

## Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

Job field focus: AI Agent roles (AI Agent Engineer/Developer, Agentic AI, LLM agent building, multi-agent systems, AI automation/workflow consulting, prompt/RAG engineering, chatbot development).

Freshness rule: only jobs posted within the current calendar month are recommended -- older postings are rejected as 'stale_posting'.

Runs every day at 8:30 AM Asia/Taipei. Every job must pass:
"I can do this job while living in Taiwan, without moving, without foreign work authorization, and without destroying my sleep schedule."

Pipeline: Fetch sources -> Normalize -> Keyword match (AI Agent field) -> Dedupe vs Raw Jobs -> Hard filter (country/hybrid keywords) -> AI Taiwan eligibility check (Claude) -> Async/timezone filter -> AI Agent role fit + scoring -> Filtered Jobs sheet -> instant alert + cover letter for 85+ -> daily digest via Telegram/Gmail.

See README.md in this repo for full setup instructions.
